title: Grants for Fees for Faith-based Preschools Run by Non-profit Organisations
what_it_is: Grants for Fees for Faith-based Preschools Run by Non-profit Organisations

sections.label: Preschool subsidies and Baby Bonus
sections.summary: Parents can use Baby Bonus Cash Gift, Child Development Account grants and subsidies to offset preschool fees for enrolled Singaporean children.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Today, parents can tap on the Baby Bonus Cash Gift, as well as the Child Development Account First Step grant of $3,000 and further matched savings to offset their children's preschool fees.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In addition, all enrolled Singaporean children in childcare centres receive a Basic Subsidy of up to $300 per month, while those from lower- to middle-income households are eligible for an Additional Subsidy of up to $440 per month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: This applies to children enrolled in all childcare centres, including those run by faith-affiliated operators, non-profit organisations or commercial entities.

sections.label: Support for not-for-profit preschools
sections.summary: Support includes not-for-profit and VWO operators, with the VWO Development Grant for not-for-profit preschools; about a third of 180 supported preschools are faith-based.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: These include some operators from not-for-profit and voluntary welfare organisations (VWOs).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We also provide targeted support through the VWO Development Grant, a capital grant extended to affordable, quality not-for-profit preschools.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Of the 180 preschools supported under these two schemes, about a third are faith-based.

sections.label: KiFAS and Preschool Opportunity Fund
sections.summary: KiFAS supports lower- and middle-income families in AOPs and MKs, while all non-AOP preschool operators can tap the Preschool Opportunity Fund.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: KiFAS, at this moment, is provided to support lower- and middle-income families in the AOPs and MKs which are generally fee-controlled.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Relating to the Opportunity Fund that the Member asked, all non-AOP preschool operators, including not-for-profit and faith-affiliated kindergartens, can tap on the Preschool Opportunity Fund.

sections.label: Review of preschool subsidies
sections.summary: The preschool subsidies are being reviewed to ensure every child has access to affordable and quality preschool education.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Currently, we are reviewing the preschool subsidies to ensure that every child has access to affordable and quality preschool education.
